description: US federal budget (Monthly Treasury Statement) — US federal receipts, outlays and deficit/surplus from the official Monthly Treasury Statement: latest month, fiscal-year-to-date, every month of the current and prior fiscal year, change vs the same period last year, and the trailing 12-month deficit, in dollars and billions. Params: date (YYYY-MM, optional, default latest published month). Source: U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data, public domain. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: econ_federal_budget
